collection.title: DS DS4 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a DS4 Hatchback 2021 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this DS4 Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: DS DS4 2021 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
